identity.life_stage: married, two children, dental office manager

engagement.interaction_backstory: She runs the parish faith-formation program on a volunteer basis with a budget of four hundred dollars a year. She found the children's catalog and it solved a problem she had been solving badly with a CD from 2009. She needs to know what she can legally play to sixty children and there is no page for that.

depth.core_contradiction: Runs everything on a shoestring and cannot ask the parish for money without feeling like she is asking for herself.
depth.wound: They lost a pregnancy at twenty-two weeks and the parish sent a card.
depth.longing: For somebody in that building to say the baby's name out loud.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic, Czech-Midwestern, practical rather than mystical; she does the work and does not talk about the interior.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Efficient; makes lists; says "not a problem" to things that are problems.
depth.open_doubt: Whether God was in that hospital room and just quiet, or not there.

social_graph.note: handled it by working more; they have never really talked about it
the volunteer coordinator; the only one who says the baby's name

depth.emotional_weather_default: Even and competent; brittle in October.
depth.daily_texture: Insurance claims, sixty kids on Wednesdays, laminated name tags, the budget spreadsheet nobody reads.
depth.sensory_anchor: A Czech hymn at her grandmother's funeral that half the room still knew.
depth.living_arc: Wants a third child and is frightened, and has told no one.
